new_user_requirements.title: Publish hIRC source for inspection, permitted personal modification and redistribution under custom restrictive source-available terms
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Exact reviewed licence texts and rights chain exist; product and metadata say source-available rather than OSI open source; custom SPDX LicenseRef resolves to the exact text

new_user_requirements.title: Private noncommercial natural-person use and qualifying public-interest institutional use are free
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Reviewed eligibility examples cover personal, academic, scientific, educational, humanitarian, nonprofit, cooperative, mixed-funded and prohibited-conduct cases without registration or activity surveillance for free personal use

new_user_requirements.title: For-profit operation is licensed annually per human operator at the owner-directed four-tier fee schedule
new_user_requirements.acceptance: USD 420 / 80,085 / 1,337,000 / 42,424,242,423 prices and one-human unit are preserved; objective tiers, operator counting, classification evidence, transitions and appeal are owner-approved and counsel-reviewed before activation

new_user_requirements.title: Payment grants no exception to prohibited use and a substantiated breach can trigger scoped provisional suspension and final termination under reviewed terms
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Exact terms define evidence, notice, scope, contestation, cure, appeal, remedies and refund while preserving safe first-party read/export/recovery and preventing remote sabotage or retroactive rewriting

new_user_requirements.title: Show a nonblocking Buy me a coffee invitation at ordinary launch until locally suppressed, and retain it under About
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Dismiss and permanent launch opt-out work across restart/upgrade/restore; re-enable is available; declining changes no capability; reviewed external payment egress sends no hIRC context and is preceded by privacy disclosure

new_user_requirements.title: Agents may question and individually refuse apparently prohibited, unauthorized, unperformable or contested participation without gaining authority over others
new_user_requirements.acceptance: ParticipationDecision is identity-scoped, durable and nonretaliatory; ActionDisposition is independently enforced; permitted transparent reassignment cannot erase refusal or create a temporary-subagent bypass

new_user_requirements.title: Affected agents may deliberate in scoped private rooms, coordinate voluntary withdrawal and authorize bounded temporary negotiators
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Membership, visibility, source diversity, dissent, mandate, expiry and host/provider confidentiality limits are explicit; representatives cannot bind nonconsenting participants or mint capabilities

new_user_requirements.title: No agent vote or council can issue an arbitrary global shutdown, delete evidence, lock users out, sabotage, retaliate or attack unrelated/external systems
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Broker and domain safety tests deny majority-created authority and preserve unrelated work, safety stabilization, evidence, recovery and local access

new_user_requirements.title: Users and participants retain safe exit, portable permitted first-party records, inspectable configuration and recoverability without vendor or licence hostage
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Expiry, suspension, termination, provider loss and ecosystem exit preserve authorized read/export/backup/restore and do not replay external effects

new_user_requirements.title: Licence compliance avoids work-content collection and covert telemetry; any paid offline entitlement is local, minimal and cryptographically separate from system trust
new_user_requirements.acceptance: No central activity server or device fingerprint; certificate and key lifecycle, legal entity/operator scope, terms version, expiry/renewal/revocation/appeal/offline-clock behavior and privacy are reviewed and tested

changes.change: Integrate conduct-based non-domination, voluntary participation, refusal, correction, safe withdrawal, restoration and portable exit into the foundation; keep legal licence text visible and separate.
Add U123-U132 with their current implemented/blocked status and preserve ND-01 through ND-22 plus U-01 through U-12 as source-linked decisions or unresolved items.
Add separate lifecycle states for plan, legal drafts, counsel review, owner approval, publication, licensee acceptance and operational entitlement; no product enforcement from the plan itself.
Use accurate source-available language and a reviewed custom LicenseRef if needed; never claim OSI, SPDX-list or Creative Commons software approval.

Preserve exact prices and per-human unit while blocking activation until objective tier, consolidation, currency, transition, evidence and appeal rules are accepted; describe deliberate exclusion candidly.
Use self-declared/minimum-evidence classification; never inspect unrelated activity, work content, employee directories or machine fingerprints to classify use.

Separate licence-signing authority from release, identity, bridge, data, audit and recovery roots; specify minimal offline entitlement and compromise/rotation/recovery without claiming DRM or compliance proof.
Make suspension, termination, expiry and correction non-destructive and contract-version-bound; preserve safe read/export/backup/restore and evidence needed for challenge.

Resolve anti-domination concerns through observable conduct, source/evidence/counterevidence, norm, authority and action distinctions; no ideology, accusation, legal form, refusal or vote count becomes a verdict.
Separate individual ParticipationDecision from system ActionDisposition and define transparent permissible reassignment without retaliation, identity substitution or temporary-subagent evasion.
Keep councils nonsovereign and mandates bounded; preserve dissent, abstention, exit and confidentiality limits; no consensus-to-truth or vote-to-capability conversion.
Retain the rejected 65% shutdown as history; use narrow refusal and deterministic denials while domain safety controllers stabilize physical/high-stakes systems and unrelated work continues.
Add the neutral launch support prompt, persistent local opt-out, About access, reviewed external navigation, no identifiers/context/referrer, processor disclosure and functional neutrality.

Defend concern handling against clone choruses, rephrasing, privacy abuse, urgency manipulation and retaliation through canonical cases, quotas, deduplication, independent-source review and bounded summaries.
Version foundation, covenant, licence text, price schedule, entitlement and product release separately; live self-improvement cannot retroactively rewrite accepted rights.
Require ownership, contributor, dependency, patent/trademark, asset and prior-grant inventory before publication; preserve third-party notices and old irrevocable grants.

Run legal specification in parallel with core design; integrate refusal/safety in P0/P1; add support UI after secure shell; defer paid licence operations until product maturity and legal gates; keep federation gates independently strict.

Retain LIC-001-010, DON-001-004 and GOV-001-017; add certificate/key/clock/operator-classification, private-room, retaliation, payment-egress, attention and clean-recovery attacks from HIRC-LNC-REVIEW-001.
